sections.text: You stand before the ruined gate of a forgotten mountain temple. A dragon's shadow circles above the clouds.

options.description: Follow the hidden trail into the forest

sections.text: Inside the gate, a rusted mechanism hums to life. The stones tremble beneath your boots.

consequence.text: You slip on the broken steps and scrape your knee.

sections.text: The forest trail narrows to a cliff edge. You hear a roar from the valley below.
The ancient mechanism reveals a hidden staircase descending into the mountain core.
The dragon notices you and breathes a stream of fire across the cliff face.

options.description: Dodge the fire and charge forward

consequence.text: The heat singes your armor and leaves you wounded.

options.description: Hide behind the rocks and wait

sections.text: You reach the dragon's lair and stand face to face with the beast. The myth becomes your truth.
